messages:
sasha: Quick sync 6mdash; launching a small posterior-driven canary for v3.3-int4. Goal: avoid knee-jerk rollbacks by combining Bayesian tie-break + seqlen bucketing + replay.

ryan: Sounds good. What priors are you using for the bayes test? We don't want it biased to pass.

sasha: Using a weakly pessimistic prior centered at -0.2% (treatment slightly worse) with sd=1.5% for MRR delta so the test favors safety without being overly conservative. For decision: require P(delta < -0.5%) > 0.975 to auto-rollback.

mai: Can we also bucket by seqlen (<256, 256-1024, >1024) and require the posterior rule to hold in any two adjacent buckets before rollback? Long-doc noise mustn't yank shortform traffic.

sasha: Yes. Bucketing added. Also: replay harness will run on curated 3k prompts including structured-output cases and privacy-edge prompts. If replay discordance >1.5% on critical prompts, block promote.

ryan: What's the ramp plan and minimum samples for a decision? Ops needs exact numbers.

sasha: Canary: 1% -> 7% -> 30%. Check windows 10m; min_sample_per_cohort=1200 per window. For seqlen buckets min_sample=300. Composite fidelity = 0.75*MRR + 0.25*(1-halluc_rate). Auto-fallback logic below.

jo: Please include KV prefetch success (first-200 req window) and a tokens-per-response cost guard. If tokens increase >12% AND fidelity drops, treat as critical.

sasha: Draft policy snippet: 

```yaml
canary:
  steps: [1,7,30]
  hold_minutes: [10,20,60]
checks:
  window: 10m
  min_samples: 1200
  seqlen_buckets: ["<256","256-1024"," >1024"]
metrics:
  mrr_delta_posterior:
    rollback_if: "P(delta < -0.005) > 0.975"
  composite_fidelity:
    threshold_rel: -0.01
  kv_prefetch_success_min: 0.96
  tokens_per_response_pct_increase: 0.12
auto_fallback_rules:
  immediate_rollback_on: [mrr_abs_drop>0.02, halluc_pp_increase>0.006, kv_prefetch<0.96]
  bayes_rollback_on: "posterior rule per seqlen; require 2 adjacent buckets"
  replay_block_if: "discordant_critical_prompts > 0.015"
flap_protection:
  cooldown_after_rollback: 3h
```

mai: Nice. Ops: can you surface per-bucket posterior traces in the dashboard and a small replay-diff table (top 25 prompts)? That speeds triage.

ryan: Also log the prior and seed for the bayes run in the diagnostic bundle so we can reproduce.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for v3.3-int4, run id r-2026032705, initial 1% traffic.

sasha: Thanks all 6mdash; running the replay now. Will post posterior plots and a short table of top discordant prompts back here when available.
